1.body:
Hello,

I saw the UI/UX Designer opening at Llineo and wanted to connect, particularly given your focus on translating ideas into digital products using data and creativity.

During my time at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings back into user flows and interface usability, alongside building brand guidelines and digital assets for startups.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates how I approach creating a cleaner verification experience and intuitive user flows for B2B teams, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and am fully ready to relocate to Pune for this role. Could we spend fifteen minutes this week discussing how my background fits your digital asset requirements?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
